function numbers(left: string | number, right: string | number) {
  if ((left = right) !== (right = 3)) console.log("different");
  else console.log(left.toFixed());
}
function strings(left: string | number, right: string | number) {
  if ((left = right) != (right = "done")) console.log("different");
  else console.log(left.toUpperCase());
}
function supported(text: string) {
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
  if ((match = /a/.exec(text)) !== null) console.log(match[0]);
}
